safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that the patient specifically did not eat out slightly reduces exposure-history specificity but is largely covered by the broader history of no “dodgy” food and no notable diet/travel exposures. This omission is unlikely to change management in an otherwise uncomplicated short-duration diarrheal illness.
